experience.summary: Leading the security programme of an enterprise AI company: governance and risk, cloud and identity, and the controls that let customers adopt AI agents with confidence.
Information and cyber security architecture for a rocket manufacturing and launch company, balancing protection of critical technology with the pace of a fast-scaling engineering organisation.
Developed detection use cases and SOAR deployments for a global managed security service provider, improving how threats were detected and handled for enterprise clients.
Led the development of a company-wide cybersecurity roadmap, aligning security measures with the business's growth strategy.
Built and ran the security operations centre's use-case library, focused SOC effort where it had most impact, and managed Active Directory and role-based access for production systems.

credentials: MBA, WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management
Organisational Leadership, Columbia Business School Executive Education
